localEquivalentBeforeStaging.providerRegistry: open-sse/providers/registry/minimax.js: alias minimax, category apikey, serviceKinds include video, video models MiniMax-H3, MiniMax-H3-Max, MiniMax-Hailuo-2.3, MiniMax-Hailuo-2.3-Fast, MiniMax-Hailuo-02 (no T2V-01-Director)
localEquivalentBeforeStaging.asyncVideoConfig: videoConfig format minimax-multi: v2 task API for H3 models, and legacyCreateUrl/legacyQueryUrl/legacyFileRetrieveUrl = the same three v1 endpoints for legacyModels (Hailuo 2.3, 2.3 Fast, 02), served by the async /v1/videos job proxy (open-sse/handlers/videoCore.js + videoProviders/minimax.js) with minimax-v1: job ids handed to the client

localEquivalentBeforeStaging.equivalenceNote: same endpoints and Bearer auth, different public contract: the async proxy returns a job id, requires duration and resolution, does not check base_resp.status_code, and has no accepted-job accounting; the source's synchronous create-poll-retrieve flow is the delta staged here

exports.createMinimaxVideoAdapter: factory; options { timeoutMs, submitTimeoutMs, requestTimeoutMs, pollIntervalMs, wait, now } for tests
exports.buildMinimaxVideoRequest: (model, body) -> { model, prompt, duration?, resolution?, first_frame_image?, prompt_optimizer?, fast_pretreatment? }; throws status 400
exports.resolveMinimaxTiming: (body) -> { timeoutMs, pollIntervalMs } from timeout_ms / poll_interval_ms with source ceilings; throws status 400
exports.runMinimaxVideoTask: create + bounded poll + file retrieve; { success, url, taskId, fileId, accounting } or error result with acceptedJob
exports.minimaxPublicUrl: public https URL check used for first frames and results
exports.MINIMAX_VIDEO_MODELS: video catalog metadata (id, name, kind, textToVideo, imageToVideo)
